Season

The process was mid-pack or better; the damage came on fastballs in the air.

  • Whiff, chase and CSW all sit above the median of 40 Phillies starter seasons; wOBA and HR/PA sit at the bottom.
  • First half .355 wOBA, second half .327, with xwOBA nearly flat (.318 → .310). August was the best month.
  • The curve earned positive run value; four-seam, sinker and cutter were all underwater.

Prior products

The 7/05 changeup pivot held; lefty first-pitch strikes never got back to his norm.

  • uc-pps-027's approach change (more changeups, fewer two-strike fastballs) held through the end of the season.
  • uc-pps-021's lefty tripwires: walks and wOBA improved; the changeup to lefties got hit harder as usage rose.

Sequencing map

What each setup adds to the next pitch, scored against that pitch in the same count.

  • vs LHB the changeup sets up the curve; vs RHB the sinker sets up the changeup and the four-seam.
  • Worst pairs: sinker → curve to lefties; changeup → four-seam to righties.

Sequence explorer

Every sequence in the receipts, filterable. Setup lift scores the last pitch of the sequence against the same pitch in the same count; endings score how the PA finished.

Selected sequence by era

Click a row (or type a sequence in Find) to see its setup lift in each era, scored against that era's own baselines.

Run prevention

He finishes hitters with the curve, and two in a row is the best ending he has.

  • 28 of 176 rankable sequences clear their 90% interval vs ~18 by chance: real signal in aggregate; treat any single one as a candidate.

Over time

The young-era book still works as a book; the pitches inside it lost value.

  • 0 sequences FADED under the pre-registered bar; 3 GREW (all vs lefties).
  • Two straight curves to righties is the one staple that slipped on raw value and lift; inside the noise, the one to watch in 2027.

Batterymates

One book for righties; a slightly different lefty book with Stubbs.

  • vs LHB p = 0.002 (2023–26) and 0.002 on 2023–25 alone; vs RHB p = 0.73.
  • Statcast cannot say who called the pitch (G4).

Predictability

Stretch S-1: the hardest-to-guess mix of his career.

Method

  • SQ-0 the client's pitch_sequence(), verbatim; SQ-1 every 2–4 pitch window inside a PA, career 2015–26 (client ruling Q-C).
  • SQ-2 setup lift: run value of the last pitch minus Nola's own mean for that pitch type, count and batter side (Q-A). Shrunk n/(n+100); 90% PA-cluster bootstrap.
  • SQ-3 endings: last 2–4 pitches of the PA scored on out, K, poor contact (PC-1 = Savant launch_speed_angle 1–3, Q-B) and xwOBA (XW-1).
  • SQ-5 eras scored on era-internal baselines; FADED bar filed in the BID before compute. SQ-6 within-season permutation of the starting catcher. PI-1 next-pitch entropy.
  • Entity lock MLBAM 605400; curveball CU (2015–16) folded into KC (PT-H). Every number comes from an out/dp_uc64_* receipt.
